results.rationale: The clouds, horizon and distant sea retain their arrangement with slight ripple-texture variation. The beach is thoroughly replaced by rounded pebbles of varied sizes and coarse sediment, matching the requested shingle coastline and explanation. The stones, surf and lighting form a coherent natural beach image.

The existing black and white pieces and board grid retain their positions, with minor board texture drift. A huge irregular black rock is added left of the top row, spanning several intersections instead of placing a normal stone immediately beside the four aligned pieces. It does not clearly form a legal five-stone line, so instruction failure makes knowledge invalid. The oversized rock is a conspicuous scale and semantic anomaly among the game pieces.
